# Yjs Invalid Access Warnings - Kit Import Issue

## Problem Summary
When importing a kit, 21,720 "Invalid access" Yjs warnings are generated. The root cause is that Y.Map/Y.Array objects have `.set()/.push()` called on them BEFORE they're attached to a Y.Doc.

## Critical Findings

### Pattern: Creating Y.Map/Y.Array, setting on parent, then nested store instantiation
The issue occurs when:
1. `new Y.Map()` is created (DETACHED from document)
2. It's set on a parent map with `.set()` (parent is already attached)
3. The new Y.Map is passed to a constructor that immediately calls `.set()` on it (INVALID - not yet in document)

### Key Locations with This Pattern

#### 1. **YPlaneStore constructor (Lines 1993-2014)**
- **Function**: YPlaneStore class constructor
- **Issue**: Creates 3 new Y.Maps (yOrigin, yXAxis, yYAxis) as detached objects
- **Problem Code**:
  ```typescript
  const yOrigin = new Y.Map<YPointVal>();  // Line 2005 - detached
  this.yPlane.set("origin", yOrigin);       // Line 2006 - sets detached map
  // yOrigin is NOT attached to doc yet!
  
  const yXAxis = new Y.Map<YVectorVal>();  // Line 2008 - detached
  this.xAxis = new YVectorStore(yXAxis, plane.xAxis);  // Line 2009 - constructor calls yXAxis.set()
  // **YVectorStore constructor immediately does `.set()` on unattached yXAxis**
  
  const yYAxis = new Y.Map<YVectorVal>();  // Line 2011
  this.yPlane.set("yAxis", yYAxis);        // Line 2012
  this.yAxis = new YVectorStore(yYAxis, plane.yAxis);  // Line 2013 - constructor calls yYAxis.set()
  ```
- **Warnings Generated**: Each `.set()` call in YVectorStore (x, y, z = 3 properties) × number of pieces/planes

#### 2. **YCameraStore constructor (Lines 2045-2058)**
- **Issue**: Same pattern as YPlaneStore with 3 nested Y.Maps
- **Problem Code**:
  ```typescript
  const yPosition = new Y.Map<YPointVal>();    // Line 2050 - detached
  this.yCamera.set("position", yPosition);     // Line 2051 - sets it
  this.position = new YPointStore(yPosition, camera.position);  // Line 2052 - constructor calls .set() on unattached
  
  const yForward = new Y.Map<YVectorVal>();    // Line 2054 - detached
  this.yCamera.set("forward", yForward);       // Line 2055
  this.forward = new YVectorStore(yForward, camera.forward);  // Line 2056 - .set() on unattached
  
  const yUp = new Y.Map<YVectorVal>();         // Line 2057 - detached
  this.yCamera.set("up", yUp);                 // Line 2058
  this.up = new YVectorStore(yUp, camera.up);  // Line 2059 - .set() on unattached
  ```
- **Warnings Generated**: 9 total per camera (3 maps × 3 properties each)

#### 3. **ConnectorStore constructor (Lines 3338-3350)**
- **Issue**: Creates yPoint and yDirection as unattached Y.Maps, passes to nested store constructors
- **Problem Code**:
  ```typescript
  this.yPoint = new Y.Map();                    // Line 3338 - detached
  this.yConnector.set("point", this.yPoint);   // Line 3339
  this.point = new YPointStore(this.yPoint, connector.point);  // Line 3340 - .set() on unattached
  
  this.yDirection = new Y.Map();                // Line 3342 - detached
  this.yConnector.set("direction", this.yDirection);  // Line 3343
  this.direction = new YVectorStore(this.yDirection, connector.direction);  // Line 3344 - .set() on unattached
  ```
- **Warnings per Connector**: 6 (2 maps × 3 properties each)

#### 4. **PieceStore constructor nested maps (Lines 4190-4210)**
- **Issue**: Creates yPlane, yCenter, yMirrorPlane as unattached, passes to YPlaneStore/YCoordStore
- **Problem Code**:
  ```typescript
  if (piece.plane) {
    this.yPlane = new Y.Map();                  // Line 4190 - detached
    this.yPiece.set("plane", this.yPlane);     // Line 4191
    this.plane = new YPlaneStore(this.yPlane, piece.plane);  // Line 4192 - creates 3 nested unattached maps!
    // YPlaneStore creates yOrigin, yXAxis, yYAxis and calls .set() on each
  }
  
  if (piece.center) {
    this.yCenter = new Y.Map();                 // Line 4195 - detached
    this.yPiece.set("center", this.yCenter);   // Line 4196
    this.center = new YCoordStore(this.yCenter, piece.center);  // Line 4197 - .set() calls on unattached
  }
  ```
- **Warnings per Piece**: 
  - If has plane: 6 warnings (YPlaneStore creates 3 maps, each triggers .set() in nested stores)
  - If has center: 2 warnings (YCoordStore does u, v)
  - If has mirrorPlane: 6 warnings

#### 5. **ModelStore constructor (Lines 3211-3233)**
- **Issue**: Creates yTags and attributes Y.Array detached, then pushes data
- **Problem Code**:
  ```typescript
  const yTags = new Y.Array<string>();         // Line 3219 - detached
  this.yModel.set("tags", yTags);              // Line 3220 - sets detached array
  this.yTags = yTags;
  
  if (model.tags) this.yTags.push(model.tags.map(t => typeof t === "string" ? t : t.guid));  // Line 3221 - .push() on unattached!
  
  const yAttributes = new Y.Array<YAttribute>();  // Line 3224 - detached
  this.yModel.set("attributes", yAttributes);     // Line 3225 - sets it
  // Loop creates nested Y.Maps and pushes them
  for (const attribute of model.attributes) {
    const yAttribute = new Y.Map<YAttributeVal>();  // Line 3227 - detached
    this.yAttributes.push([yAttribute]);             // Line 3228 - .push() unattached array then set on it
    yAttribute.set("guid", attribute.guid);         // Lines 3229-3232 - .set() on unattached map
  ```
- **Warnings per Model**: 
  - If has tags: 1 warning from .push()
  - Per attribute: 1 warning from .push() + 4 warnings from .set() (guid, key, value, definition)
  - If model has 100 attributes: ~500 warnings just from ModelStore

#### 6. **DesignStore constructor large loops (Lines 5454-5522)**
- **Issue**: Multiple large loops creating nested structures
- **Problem Code** (example from pieces loop):
  ```typescript
  const yDesignPieces = new Y.Array<YPiece>();  // Line 5454 - detached
  this.yDesign.set("pieces", yDesignPieces);    // Line 5455 - sets it
  if (design.pieces) {
    for (const piece of design.pieces) {         // START LARGE LOOP
      this.createPiece(piece);                   // Line 5459 - calls createPiece
    }
  }
  ```
  
  In createPiece (line 5719):
  ```typescript
  const yPiece = new Y.Map<YPieceVal>();        // detached
  this.yPieces!.push([yPiece]);                  // push unattached map to array (triggers warnings)
  const yPieceStore = new PieceStore(this, yPiece, piece);  // Line 5720 - constructor does .set() calls
  ```
  
  PieceStore then does:
  - 12-14 `.set()` calls for basic properties
  - If has plane: YPlaneStore with 9 nested `.set()` calls
  - If has center: YCoordStore with 2 `.set()` calls
  - If has mirrorPlane: YPlaneStore with 9 nested `.set()` calls
  - Creates attributes Y.Array and loops through attributes

**Similar loops exist for**:
- connections (line 5461)
- attributes (line 5468)
- stats (line 5479)
- props (line 5489)
- layers (line 5498)
- groups (line 5510)
- concepts (line 5518)

#### 7. **TypeStore constructor (Lines 3481-3550)**
- Creates nested Y.Arrays (yTypeAttributes, yTypeAuthors, yTypeModels, yTypeConnectors)
- Each followed by loops that call createAttribute, createModel, createPort
- Each create method generates warnings

## Execution Flow Example: Kit Import with Large Design

```
KitStore constructor (Line 6684) runs in transaction:
  ├─ kit.designs.forEach → createDesign
  │   └─ DesignStore constructor:
  │       ├─ const yDesignPieces = new Y.Array<YPiece>();  // DETACHED
  │       ├─ this.yDesign.set("pieces", yDesignPieces);    // set it
  │       ├─ for (100 pieces):
  │       │   └─ createPiece:
  │       │       ├─ const yPiece = new Y.Map();  // DETACHED
  │       │       ├─ this.yPieces!.push([yPiece]);  // ⚠️ WARNING #1
  │       │       └─ new PieceStore(this, yPiece, piece):
  │       │           ├─ yPiece.set("type", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING #2-13 (12 properties)
  │       │           ├─ if (piece.plane):
  │       │           │   ├─ const yPlane = new Y.Map();  // DETACHED
  │       │           │   ├─ yPiece.set("plane", yPlane);  // set it
  │       │           │   └─ new YPlaneStore(yPlane, plane):
  │       │           │       ├─ const yOrigin = new Y.Map();  // DETACHED
  │       │           │       ├─ yPlane.set("origin", yOrigin);
  │       │           │       └─ new YPointStore(yOrigin):
  │       │           │           ├─ yOrigin.set("x", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING  
  │       │           │           ├─ yOrigin.set("y", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING
  │       │           │           └─ yOrigin.set("z", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING
  │       │           │       ├─ const yXAxis = new Y.Map();  // DETACHED
  │       │           │       └─ new YVectorStore(yXAxis):
  │       │           │           ├─ yXAxis.set("x", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING
  │       │           │           ├─ yXAxis.set("y", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING
  │       │           │           └─ yXAxis.set("z", ...);  // ⚠️ WARNING
  │       │           │       └─ (same for yYAxis = 3 more warnings)
  │       │           └─ (12-15 warnings per piece with full geometry)
  │       │
  │       ├─ for (100+ connections): (similar nested structure)
  │       ├─ for (50+ attributes):   (2 warnings each)
  │       ├─ for (50+ stats):        (2 warnings each)
  │       └─ and more loops...
  │
  ├─ kit.types.forEach → createType
  │   └─ TypeStore constructor: (similar nested array/map creation)
  └─ kit.attributes.forEach → createAttribute
```

## Why 21,720 Warnings?

If a kit import contains:
- 50 designs, each with 100 pieces (5,000 pieces total)
- Each piece with full geometry (plane, center, mirrorPlane)
- Each design with 100+ connections
- Each design with 50+ attributes
- Each design with 50+ stats...

Each piece in a design can generate:
- 1 warning from yPiece push
- 12 warnings from piece property sets
- 6 warnings from plane geometry (yOrigin, yXAxis, yYAxis nested) 
- 2 warnings from center coordinate
- 6 warnings from mirrorPlane geometry
- 4-5 warnings per attribute (if has attributes)
= **~35-40 warnings per piece** with full geometry

5,000 pieces × 40 = **200,000+ potential warnings**

The actual 21,720 suggests a kit with ~500-1000 nested structures being created/set in the problematic way.

## Summary of All Problematic Lines

| Location | Issue Type | Lines | Warnings Per Item |
|----------|-----------|-------|------------------|
| YCoordStore | Sets on unattached map | 1646-1660 | 2 |
| YPlaneStore | Creates 3 unattached maps | 1993-2014 | 9 |
| YCameraStore | Creates 3 unattached maps | 2045-2058 | 9 |
| ConnectorStore | Creates 2 unattached maps | 3338-3350 | 6 |
| ModelStore | Creates unattached array + maps | 3211-3233 | 4-5 per attribute |
| TypeStore | Creates unattached arrays + nested | 3481-3550 | Variable |
| DesignStore | Creates unattached arrays + loops | 5420-5522 | Variable (100+ per design) |
| PieceStore | Creates unattached maps | 4190-4210 | 12-40 per piece |
| KitStore | Calls create* in transaction | 6724-6730 | Aggregates all above |
